title: Quick Aerated Ethiopian Mussels Stew
description: A flavorful and dairy-free-friendly stew featuring mussels, onions, garlic, and spices, finished with a light, aerated texture.

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: use a neutral-tasting oil like canola or grapeseed

ingredients.name: white wine
ingredients.notes: use a dry white wine, such as chardonnay or sauvignon blanc

instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are softened and lightly browned.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cayenne pepper, cumin, and curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the mussels and wine (if using) and stir to combine.
Cover the saucepan and cook, stirring occasionally, until the mussels are opened and the liquid is bubbly.
Stir in the white wine vinegar.
Continue cooking, uncovered, for 2-3 minutes, or until the liquid has thickened slightly and the mussels are coated in a light, aerated sauce.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the mussels hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs like parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice or couscous for a filling meal.
